final_decision.reason: Each practice attempt barely improves the skill (learning rate about 0.003), so it costs more than it gains.
A reset costs 100 and leads only to toss practice that keeps failing with little learning, so it is not worth more than stopping now.
Tossing is the weakest skill (~35% success) and is directly practicable now without a costly human reset.
A far reset sets up more practice of the still-weak over-barrier toss.
